name: length_myRev
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem length_myRev (xs : List α) : (myRev xs).length = xs.length
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, ih]
  have rev_eq (zs : List α) : myRev zs = zs.reverse := by
    induction zs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.reverse_cons]
  rw [rev_eq, List.length_reverse]
strategies: Direct induction calculating lengths of appended singletons.
Characterize myRev as reverse and apply length_reverse.
